downstreamResponsibilities: Decide whether to admit an intake at all.
Mint/assign ResearchRef only if a research track is actually admitted.
Create native QuestionRef/Charter according to owner/Lab policy; no globally standardized Question/Charter schema is required.
Freeze any InvestigationContract before evidential work begins if the intake proceeds to NATIVE investigation.
Preserve source authority fences and evidence scope; Atlas evidence is routing evidence, not owner conclusion authority.
Return rejection/defer/split outcomes without forcing Atlas topology changes.

minimumEnvelope.AtlasCandidateProposalRef: Stable Atlas-local routing identity; explicitly NOT a ResearchRef and does not imply project/owner admission.
minimumEnvelope.admissionFirewall: Explicit statement that no ResearchRef, QuestionRef, project, semantic owner or Foundation is admitted by the handoff.
minimumEnvelope.discriminants: Questions/rivals/negative routes that downstream Question/Charter should preserve if admitted.
minimumEnvelope.ownerBoundaryConstraints: Existing-owner non-absorption and non-duplication constraints discovered by Atlas.
minimumEnvelope.sourceEvidenceRefs: Exact Atlas evidence/audit refs supporting proposal-review eligibility.
minimumEnvelope.sourceFence: Exact External Reference revision or authority fences used by the routing decision.
minimumEnvelope.suggestedScope: Bounded candidate problem family, not a MajorRegion by default.
minimumEnvelope.targetIntakeRole: QUESTION_CHARTER_INTAKE only; Atlas does not define the downstream implementation endpoint.
